quota_interpretation: The requested 3000–5000 original training examples count independent training winners. Validation/test are additional later-time full resolved pools, not removed to fill training. This refines the initially ambiguous all-split quota without changing discovery, labels, costs, or cutoffs.
cluster_rule: Canonical asset and direction, representatives more than 4 hours apart across venue/timeframe; choose by morphology quality before profit labels.
selection: Stable event SHA order if more than 5000 train winners; never select on net R magnitude.
reference_exclusion: Exclude val/test same canonical asset within 4h of any frozen calibration reference anchor.
